title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free matched public evaluation evidence
evidence_status: bounded public benchmark evidence; no automatic policy change

context_overlap: I1 and R1 share the hash-cap defect/source context
I3 and R2 share the mid-session-reply defect/source context
design.classification: public snapshots and synthetic fixtures only
design.assignment: one prepared public snapshot per task/arm; no reference snapshot or opponent context; deterministic trusted oracle evaluated after first pass
design.execution_isolation_limit: No hard filesystem sandbox was established; T3 worktree separation is not a hard filesystem boundary. No bwrap canary was run under the later authorization.

aggregate_results.whole_task_acceptance: DeepSeek R2 exceeded permitted inspection scope by reading select_cands.py outside the cmd_run-only prompt. Its structured gate passed, but the whole task did not comply with scope. Therefore the set has 16 deterministic gate passes, not 16 unqualified task acceptances.

eligible_operations.basis: 4/4 DeepSeek and 4/4 matched comparator implementation gates passed; finite deterministic oracle coverage only.
2/2 DeepSeek and 2/2 matched comparator structured-answer gates passed; known public facts with deterministic checks only.

proposed_eligibility.qualification_status: provisional; additional router checks and independent review remain pending
required_conditions: current evidence for temporary free source pricing and terms

source_price.status: temporary free as listed by OpenCode
source_price.distinction: Source fee only; not an observation of provider usage or total workflow cost.

provider_terms_context.caveat: The model listing describes provider zero retention/no training; OpenCode terms separately say content from unpaid service use may be used to improve OpenCode services.

methodology.first_pass: First completed agent turn before acceptance feedback. Visible tests/tools were allowed. Every tool/test attempt was counted from transcript activity; tests include failed setup/baseline attempts.
methodology.implementation_oracle: Frozen offline behavior tests plus edit-scope and fixture-integrity checks; finite suite pass is not proof of no regression.
methodology.review_oracle: Strict JSON schema/enumerated expected facts and pinned source span checks; both probes are known-defect constrained classifications, not open-ended reviews.
methodology.docs_oracle: Strict JSON schema/enumerated expected facts checked against pinned public README source snapshots; docs were first-pass-only.
methodology.timing: Queue, model turn, and trusted oracle times measured separately in seconds; row-level measurements and per-arm/category medians included.
methodology.repairs: At most one paired anonymous repair was allowed for implementation/review if needed; none was needed. No docs repair was authorized in this frozen design.
methodology.failure_handling: All planned task/arm rows retained. All 16 completed; no missing arms, provider errors, throttles or timeouts.

Use the v2 behavior commands: python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_policy_outcomes.py tests/test_eval_hash_boundaries.py.

limitations: Eight purposively selected public tasks cover six source contexts; no statistical generalization.
I1/R1 and I3/R2 are overlapping contexts and must not be treated as independent replications.
Known prompts, historical tests, reference fixes and visible tests are public and may be memorized; no hidden holdout.
Two review probes have enumerated answers and known defects; no clean-code controls, open-ended defect discovery, or audit false-positive estimate.
DeepSeek R2 violated the requested cmd_run-only inspection scope despite passing structured answer oracle.
No hard runtime filesystem sandbox proof; public-only execution boundary was accepted for this run.
Task and proof-class labels are caller-declared; not content scanning or proof certification.
One run per arm per task; no repeated-run variance estimate.
Provider usage and workflow costs were not reported; source price is not an observed cost.
privacy_exclusions: personal information unrelated to the public benchmark
